subject: Unable to change cutpoint for light intensity PA

messages.author: a3527f6489543e9b
messages.subject: Unable to change cutpoint for light intensity PA
parts:
Hi all,

I have changed the codes accordingly by applying different set of cutpoints for determination of PA patterns among my participants. However the output for LPA (from part5: dur_day_LIG40_314_min; filename of part5: part5_daysummary_MM_L40M314V998_T5A5.csv) still seems to be based on 40mg (default) which is different from what I put in (i.e. 191mg). I wonder if anyone is having the same issue? Can anyone please tell me which part went wrong with it?

Below is the code that I am using:

g.shell.GGIR(mode=c(1,2,3,4,5), datadir="/", outputdir="/Users/khc745/Documents/GENEActiv analysis/Results", f0=1, f1=1, desiredtz="Australia/NSW", do.bfen=TRUE, lb=0.2, hb=15, do.anglez=TRUE, chunksize=1, printsummary=TRUE, strategy = 1, ndayswindow=6, hrs.del.start = 0, hrs.del.end = 0, maxdur = 6, includedaycrit = 16, qwindow=c(0,24), mvpathreshold = 314, overwrite=TRUE, bout.metric = 4, closedbout = FALSE, timethreshold=5, anglethreshold=5, ignorenonwear=TRUE, excludefirstlast = FALSE, includenightcrit = 16, loglocation ="/Users/khc745/Documents/GENEActiv_sleeplog", outliers.only=TRUE, criterror=4, relyonsleeplog=FALSE, sleeplogidnum=FALSE, colid=1, coln=2, nnights =6, threshold.lig.=191, threshold.mod=314, threshold.vig=998, boutcriter=0.8, boutcriter.in=0.9, boutcriter.lig=0.8, boutcriter.mvpa=0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig=c(1,10), boutdur.mvpa=c(1), timewindow = c("MM"),  do.report=c(2,4,5), visualreport=TRUE, dofirstpage = TRUE, viewingwindow=1)

Thank you and best regards,
John.

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Unable to change cutpoint for light intensity PA
parts:
Hi John,
There seems to be a dot at the end of "threshold.lig.". Removing the dot problem address the problem.
Best, Vincent
